propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal when run after reconciler entrypoint tests, but passes in isolation
the rebar_reconciler root logger level is set to WARNING by install_stderr_handler and never restored, poisoning all later tests in the same worker
the INFO-level pass summary line is dropped by isEnabledFor at the originating logger before caplog handlers see it, while the WARNING-level per-item line still propagates
caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument only raises the ROOT logger level, not intermediate loggers like rebar_reconciler, leaving the leak uncovered
the existing _rebar_log_propagation_guard in conftest.py is hardcoded to the single root 'rebar' and misses the sibling 'rebar_reconciler' root documented in rebar/_logging.py
the fix generalizes the guard from one shared root to a tuple of shared roots (rebar, rebar_reconciler) by making the level snapshot/restore primitives operate over all of them
